name: rotary-knob
title: Volume Knob
description: Hi-fi volume knob synced to a shadcn <Slider> (the accessible control) and a mute Button. Drag the knob up/down, scroll on it, or use the slider. Ticks light up around the dial. Hover: the knob lifts, glows and the lit ticks shimmer. Disabled: no drag, dial greys out.
